package student_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	studenthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

const nextOwner = `{"schema":"student-next-action.v1","policy_version":"student-next-action-policy.v1","status":"READY","primary":{"kind":"RESUME_PRACTICE","target":{"task_instance_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"}},"secondary_actions":[{"kind":"ASK_TEACHER","target":{}}],"reason_code":"practice_active","source_versions":{"context_version":3,"path_version":7,"runtime_version":"sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb","state_digest":"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}}`

func TestNextActionClientReadsExactOwnerAndPreservesDecision(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		calls++
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/next-action", r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "teacher-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(nextOwner))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "legacy", LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	action, err := client.GetNextAction(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, calls)
	payload, err := json.Marshal(action)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, nextOwner, string(payload))
}

func TestNextActionClientAcceptsActualPracticeValidationScope(t *testing.T) {
	body := strings.Replace(nextOwner, `"runtime_version":"sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"`, `"runtime_version":"sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"`, 1)
	body = strings.Replace(body, `"task_instance_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"`, `"task_instance_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","submission_scope":"MILESTONE"`, 1)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(body))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	action, err := client.GetNextAction(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "MILESTONE", action.Primary.Target.SubmissionScope)
}
func TestNextActionClientFailsClosedOnContractCorruption(t *testing.T) {
	for _, body := range []string{nextOwner + `{}`, strings.Replace(nextOwner, `"status":"READY"`, `"status":"WAITING"`, 1), strings.Replace(nextOwner, `"reason_code":`, `"priority":1,"reason_code":`, 1), strings.Replace(nextOwner, `"context_version":3,`, "", 1), strings.Replace(nextOwner, `"target":{"task_instance_id"`, `"target":{"workspace_token":"private","task_instance_id"`, 1)} {
		t.Run(body[:30], func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				_, _ = w.Write([]byte(body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.GetNextAction(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
			require.Error(t, err)
		})
	}
	_, err := (studenthttp.Client{}).GetNextAction(context.Background(), "bad")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest)
}
